title: Government Boosts Green Hydrogen Production: What the Expanded PLI Scheme Means for You
description: The Indian government recently announced an expansion of its Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme for Green Hydrogen. This new push specifically targets m.

faq.a: An electrolyser is a device that uses electricity to split water (H₂O) into hydrogen (H₂) and oxygen (O₂). When the electricity comes from renewable sources like solar or wind, the hydrogen produced is called Green Hydrogen.

faq.q: What is the overall goal of India's National Green Hydrogen Mission?
faq.a: The mission aims to make India a global hub for Green Hydrogen production, utilisation, and export. It targets achieving a Green Hydrogen production capacity of 5 Million Metric Tonnes (MMT) per annum by 2030, attracting over ₹8 lakh crore in investments, and creating over 6 lakh jobs.

faq.q: How long will these incentives be available?
faq.a: The SIGHT programme, under which these PLI incentives are offered, is designed to support the initial phases of Green Hydrogen and electrolyser manufacturing. The specific duration of the incentives for this expanded phase would be detailed in the government's official notification, typically spanning several years to allow companies to establish production.

faq.q: Will this make petrol and diesel cheaper?
faq.a: Directly, no. Green Hydrogen is a different fuel primarily aimed at industrial use, heavy transport, and power generation. However, by reducing India's overall reliance on imported fossil fuels, it could indirectly contribute to energy security and potentially stabilise energy prices in the long run.
